title: Trips: share a link, publish as a Personal Guide, and counts for businesses and places
why: decisions/0174 release 4 (accepted 2026-11-19). Share makes a view-only link to a trip ('anyone with the link can view it, not edit it. The link can be turned off any time', 0174 §1); turning it on again makes a new link. Publish as a Personal Guide makes a trip public and credited ('checked like a journey before it shows', 0174 §1; 0058 §1): a contributor only, the journeys' automated check, reportable, and staff hide it in Admin → Journeys; it's a content page with likes, comments and the Link button (0058 §20). Shown publicly, a place kept private never appears, nor its name; a business marked closed shows greyed. Businesses see 'Added to trips' in their insights, and Admin → Insights lists places added to trips: counts only, never who (0058 §13, 0094, 0087). Account deletion hides and empties a person's guides, as journeys (0174 §6). No AI, no outside calls, no cost.

changes.what: A trip's page: Share, and Publish as a guide
